## Execution tips

- Grip opposite upper-middle cylindrical can walls, avoiding the lid and upper/lower rolled rims. Open slightly wider than the diameter and confirm the fingers straddle it before closing rather than touching only the top without surrounding the body.
- When bringing both cans near the box opening at once, offset their positions and the grippers along the opening's long edge, and leave room to adjust above the rim to reduce contact between the two grippers.
- When clearing the box rim, keep both the can base and fingertips above it, then lower slowly into the opening. Avoid hitting the wall or moving the lightweight box.
- Choose a lowering position with room for finger opening between the box walls and other can. Keep the can upright and obtain bottom support before release to reduce tipping during landing or withdrawal.
